sources.snippet: Origins carries 1-year limited warranty for original residential purchasers. Covers defects in materials and workmanship only. NOT transferable. Labor NOT covered. Excludes humidity damage outside 30-50 percent RH range, sunlight, household cleaners, moisture, warping from environmental conditions. Shortest warranty in Timberlake lineup by wide margin.

sources.snippet: Thermofoil PVC film on MDF delaminates when adhesive bond breaks down under repeated heat and moisture exposure. Industry sources consistently identify surfaces near toasters coffee makers stovetop splatter zones dishwashers as failure locations. Endemic to all thermofoil cabinet lines not Timberlake-specific. White and Pebble Origins finishes carry this risk. Umber stain does not.
sources.classification_reason: Category-wide material vulnerability documentation. Two of three Origins finishes are thermofoil making this a significant scoring consideration.

sources.snippet: 17 manufacturing facilities in US plus four Mexico facilities in Tijuana and Monterrey. Labor-intensive fabrication door components drawer parts done in Mexico. Final cabinet assembly completed in US facilities. Hardwood raw materials sourced from Appalachian region. Third-largest cabinet manufacturer in North America. Publicly traded NASDAQ AMWD.
sources.classification_reason: Corporate structure and manufacturing data for report context and source traceability assessment.

bottom_line: Timberlake Origins is a competently manufactured KCMA-certified stock builder-grade cabinet meeting code but falling below professional minimum quality criteria on multiple counts: no plywood option, non-dovetail drawers, partial-extension side-mount slides, no soft-close standard, thermofoil on two of three finishes, and a 1-year non-transferable warranty. MLKD B+ at PL3 assumes upgraded construction that Origins does not receive. KCMA A161.1 confirmed active February 2026 despite October 2022 resignation — American Woodmark re-certified. Primary failure risk is thermofoil delamination near heat sources on White and Pebble finishes. Former employee account describes high-throughput production environment with systemic QC pressure. Publicly traded parent with no financial distress indicators. Multi-brand same-product strategy criticized by primary industry authority.
